product_summary.goal: Provide one Windows 11 user with a private, modern local news-reading application that makes source control, personalization, ranked reading, and library actions understandable without exposing internal ranking or persistence models.
users: The repository owner as the sole local user
non_goals: Accounts, multi-user access, or device synchronization
Background Windows service operation or ingestion while the executable is closed
External AI services, bundled embedding models, or a separate local model service
Automatic source discovery, folders, annotations, exports, or research workflows
Broad scraping, paywall bypass, authentication bypass, access-control bypass, or publisher-restriction bypass
Remote geocoding, browser/IP location, analytics, tracking, accounts, or cloud-backed UI convenience services
Exposing raw normalized ranking weights or contribution floats as the normal consumer interaction model

safety_boundaries: Fetch only configured public sources and honor source terms, robots guidance, rate limits, and explicit adapter allowlists.
Never bypass paywalls, authentication, access controls, or publisher restrictions.
Persist and render full article content only when the feed or source permission supplies it; otherwise retain metadata, excerpt, and canonical publisher URL.
Keep profile data, article processing, similarity calculation, and ranking on the local machine.
Collect demographic values only through explicit optional user input; do not infer them, and allow every demographic signal to be disabled.
Store API secrets through a credential-store port backed by Windows Credential Manager; never place secret values in SQLite, logs, fixtures, or repository files.
Bind the local HTTP server to loopback by default and do not expose it to the LAN without a future explicit requirement.
Keep profile, source, ranking, library, refresh, and feed-filter state authoritative in SQLite; redesigning the UI must not move personal state into browser storage.
Present age, gender, and location as optional secondary controls while preserving explicit user input, explicit publisher audience metadata, neutral disabled behavior, and demographic caps.

repo_split.name: news-aggregator
repo_split.purpose: Single monorepo and distributable application containing the Go host, Vue PWA, shared API contract, migrations, packaging, and verification.
contains: cmd/news-aggregator: composition root, loopback server startup, browser launch, and embedded frontend
internal/domain: dependency-free entities, value objects, and port interfaces
internal/application: ingestion, ranking, library, profile, source, and refresh use cases
internal/adapters: SQLite, feed/API/scraper, credential-store, clock, and HTTP implementations
internal/httpapi: versioned REST handlers, request validation, error mapping, and generated/static contract checks
web: Vue + TypeScript PWA source, generated API client/types, and browser tests
packaging/windows: build metadata and smoke-test scripts

domain_model.name: UserProfile
fields: id fixed to the single local profile
interests and per-interest weights
preferred source identifiers
country and region with optional city
optional age and gender values
per-demographic-signal enabled flags and low-weight caps
ranking preferences and updated timestamp
relations: Produces RankingConfiguration together with explicit source preferences
Never leaves the local process or SQLite database

domain_model.name: Source
fields: id, display name, canonical URL, source kind, enabled state
adapter configuration without secret values
content permission mode: metadata-only or full-content-allowed
policy review metadata for scraper sources
refresh cursor, last success, last error, and retry metadata
relations: Produces zero or more Articles through exactly one ingestion adapter
May reference a credential key identifier stored outside SQLite

domain_model.name: Article
fields: id and stable deduplication fingerprint
source id, canonical URL, title, author, publication timestamp, fetched timestamp
excerpt and optional permitted full content
normalized language, topics, and token statistics
current relevance score and explanation components

domain_model.name: LibraryState
fields: article id
read timestamp
saved timestamp
hidden timestamp
relations: Provides explicit behavior signals to ranking

domain_model.name: RankingConfiguration
fields: recency, interest, source preference, behavior, location, age, gender, and text-similarity weights
hard caps for optional demographic contributions
enabled flags and normalization parameters
relations: Consumes UserProfile and explicit application defaults

domain_model.name: RankingResult
fields: article id and total normalized score
ordered per-signal contributions
human-readable explanation tokens
ranking algorithm version and calculated timestamp
relations: Computed locally from Article, LibraryState, and RankingConfiguration

domain_model.name: RefreshRun
fields: id, start and finish timestamps, status
per-source fetched, inserted, updated, skipped, and failed counts
sanitized error summaries without credentials or full restricted content
relations: Coordinates configured Source adapters and article indexing

frontend_screens.name: First-run setup
frontend_screens.notes: Use four clearly separated steps: accessible interest chips, optional human-facing Country plus City or area, selectable starter-source rows/cards, and one Finish setup action. Keep age/gender collapsed under Additional personalization and hide numeric weight controls.

frontend_screens.name: Ranked feed
renders_from: GET /api/v1/feed with pagination and basic filters
frontend_screens.notes: Use a clear page header, compact refresh action/status, coherent responsive filter bar, visually distinct article cards, and concise backend-driven Why this appeared reasons. Hide raw contribution floats by default; hidden articles remain excluded by default.

frontend_screens.name: Article reader
frontend_screens.notes: Render sanitized full content only when content permission is full-content-allowed; otherwise render metadata/excerpt and direct the user to the canonical publisher URL.

frontend_screens.name: Personal library
renders_from: GET /api/v1/feed filtered by saved, read, unread, or hidden state
frontend_screens.notes: Support saved, read/unread, and hidden management with persistent filters using the same card, action, empty-state, spacing, and responsive design primitives as the feed.

frontend_screens.name: Sources and refresh
frontend_screens.notes: Present configured sources as scannable cards/rows with plain-language enabled, permission, adapter, credential, and policy states. Provide examples and corrective help for custom source fields, and keep refresh outcomes compact with accessible details.

frontend_screens.name: Profile and ranking settings
frontend_screens.notes: Organize Settings into Personalization, Ranking, and Privacy & local data. Use semantic ranking presets/influence controls over the existing bounded configuration, keep raw values advanced-only if retained, and explain optional local demographic behavior without making it prominent.

backend_services.name: Local HTTP host
backend_services.responsibility: Bind to loopback, serve the versioned JSON API and embedded PWA assets, coordinate graceful shutdown, and open the default browser after readiness.

backend_services.name: Source service
backend_services.responsibility: Validate and persist editable starter/custom source configuration while separating credential identifiers from secret values.

backend_services.name: Ingestion service
backend_services.responsibility: Run bounded manual refreshes through RSS/Atom, official API, or allowlisted scraper adapters; normalize, deduplicate, and persist articles and refresh outcomes.

backend_services.name: Ranking service
backend_services.responsibility: Compute deterministic normalized scores from explicit weighted signals and local text similarity, cap demographic contributions, version the algorithm, and emit explanation components.

backend_services.name: Feed and library service
backend_services.responsibility: Query ranked articles with pagination and filters and atomically update read, saved, and hidden state.

backend_services.name: Persistence service
backend_services.responsibility: Own SQLite connections, transactions, migrations, repositories, and restart-safe state while excluding API secret values.

core_engine_responsibilities: Define dependency-free domain types and ports before frontend and adapter work branches diverge.
Normalize source payloads into one Article representation and deduplicate using canonical URL plus stable content identity rules.
Tokenize and index locally for lightweight text similarity with deterministic fixtures and no network dependency.
Normalize signal contributions into bounded comparable values, cap demographic effects, and retain each contribution for explanations.
Recompute affected ranking results after ingestion, profile changes, ranking-configuration changes, or library feedback.
Enforce content-permission and scraper-policy decisions independently of presentation code.
Keep adapter failures isolated per source so one failing feed does not discard successful refresh work.
Provide clock, HTTP fetcher, credential store, and persistence ports for deterministic testing.
verification_tasks: Run Go formatting, static analysis, unit tests, race-enabled tests where supported, and backend integration tests against temporary SQLite databases.
Run frontend formatting/linting, type checking, unit/component tests, and production build.
Validate OpenAPI compatibility between Go handlers and the generated TypeScript client/types.
Exercise a fixture-driven ingestion path covering RSS success, duplicate suppression, partial adapter failure, retry metadata, and prohibited full-content handling.
Exercise ranking fixtures covering determinism, bounded weights, demographic disablement and caps, text-similarity contribution, and explanation-total consistency.
Run a critical-path browser test from first-run profile and source selection through refresh, ranked feed, explanation, save/read/hide actions, and restart persistence.
Cross-compile or build the Windows executable and smoke-test startup, loopback binding, embedded assets, migration, browser-open behavior, and clean shutdown on Windows CI.
Verify secrets never appear in SQLite, API responses, logs, snapshots, fixtures, or committed files.
Require the independent reviewer to report requirements alignment, safety-boundary compliance, test evidence, and an approve-or-reject decision.

Test semantic ranking presets and influence controls against exact persisted RankingConfiguration values while preserving caps, deterministic behavior, and compatibility with existing saved configurations.

Exercise redesigned onboarding, Settings, feed filters, compact refresh state, article cards, explanations, Sources, and Library at desktop and approximately 390-pixel widths with keyboard and automated accessibility checks.
Inspect rendered screenshots for grouping, hierarchy, spacing, overflow, action priority, helper text, and raw technical-data leakage; passing unit tests alone is not sufficient visual proof.

Extend the real-process workflow to prove profile, sources, library, ranking settings, and authoritative feed filters survive a Go-process restart and that loopback-only/network/storage privacy audits remain clean.

starter_prompts.intake_interviewer: Use the merged assembly/intake/project_intake.json and assembly/requirements/REQUIREMENTS.md as fixed requirements; reopen intake only for a genuinely blocking product decision.
starter_prompts.planning_agent: Maintain planning-only artifacts, preserve merged requirements, define contracts before parallel lanes, and defer executable task identifiers to the Task Splitter.
starter_prompts.contract_steward: Establish api/openapi.yaml, domain ports, migration ownership, error semantics, pagination, refresh status, ranking explanation shapes, and test fixtures before parallel implementation; do not implement user-facing features beyond contract proof.
starter_prompts.frontend_builder: Build the Vue PWA as a coherent consumer news reader against accepted contracts. Own shared design tokens/primitives, progressive disclosure, semantic ranking-control mapping, responsive layouts, and accessible interactions; never persist authoritative domain state or secrets in browser storage, duplicate ranking logic, or expose raw technical values as the default UX.
starter_prompts.backend_builder: Build the Go composition root, application/domain services, adapters, SQLite persistence, credential integration, ranking, ingestion, and versioned API against accepted contracts; do not edit Vue feature code except generated bindings or integration fixtures.
starter_prompts.core_engine_builder: Keep ingestion normalization, deduplication, text similarity, score normalization, demographic caps, and explanations deterministic, local, adapter-independent, and covered by fixtures.
starter_prompts.red_team_verifier: Independently review every implementation PR; reject changes that violate merged scope, local privacy, credential handling, scraping/content permissions, loopback binding, contract compatibility, or required proof. For the UX overhaul, inspect actual desktop/narrow rendered evidence and reject technically passing work that remains confusing, inconsistent, inaccessible, or exposes internal ranking data in normal workflows.
